executable_freeze_contract.rule: Freeze exactly one executable for each incompatible accepted build configuration in T00, then reuse those exact executables for every later ticket without rebuilding or compile-time-superset substitution.

superset_probe.local_single: parallel-all runs medium-cross-owner-runtime directly and its selected outputs match local-single.
superset_probe.local_mtp: parallel-all run directly with --mtp-threads=2 on medium-cross-owner-runtime terminates with SIGSEGV in ns3::UbRemoteLink::TransmitStart().
superset_probe.conclusion: A single superset binary cannot cover all four accepted runtime modes; retain all three exact frozen variants.

cases.intent: Two directly connected nodes, one explicit RTP TP, and one URMA_WRITE operation.
Four concurrent bidirectional READ/WRITE operations share one explicit RTP TP.
One four-segment operation stripes over three TPs while a deterministic PSN-1 loss requires GBN recovery.
Four concurrent CTP READ/WRITE operations cover wildcard and explicit endpoint-port pairs across two VL priorities with queue sampling enabled.
A positive-delay two-node link crosses runtime owners under local MTP, MPI, and hybrid execution.

characterized_runtime_difference.reason: Parallel paths apply the positive 20 ns link delay as dependency-visibility lookahead; each runtime is compared to its own frozen hash. Task statistics, throughput, and selected traces remain byte-identical across runtimes.
